thread:
Maya: Heads up — we need a Q2 plan for hosted API GPUs. Partner launch in May could push token volume up fast.
Jordan: Do we have an updated GPU-hour forecast? I pulled weekly RPS vs tokens, looks like +38% token volume for May/June if conversion holds.
Santiago: Ran the sim — baseline ~150k GPU-hours/month, projected ~205k (+37%). With 80% target utilization we need ~236k-260k hours depending on buffer.
Maya: Share calc please.
Santiago: ```
# simplified calc
current_hours = 150000
growth = 1.37
buffer = 1.15
required = int(current_hours * growth * buffer)
# required = 236250 (~236k GPU-hours/month)
```
Liam: Ops prefers 25% burst buffer, 15% is risky. Also remember training/ops maintenance windows consume ~6% of pool.
Jordan: Finance leaning toward leasing to avoid big capex, but procurement lead times vary.
finproc: FYI procurement notes: preferred-vendor buy lead time = 12-14 weeks, open-market buys ~8-10 weeks, lease/short-term capacity ~2-3 weeks but ~30-45% premium on cost.
ops-bot: Monitor: hosted-api pool health — median latency p95 up 12% last 24h, KV cache hit rate down 4%, autoscaler nodes at 72% of current soft limit.
Maya: Options on table:
1) Lease interim capacity (~150 cards) and optimize batching/evictions now
2) Buy a core set (50-100) and lease spikes
3) Route non-low-latency traffic to APAC partner pool (if network cost/latency acceptable)
Santiago: Rough cost/impact sketch: 
- Buy 100 A100-eq = ~$4.2M capex (one-time)
- Lease 200 A100-eq for 3 months = ~$650k opex
- Mixed: buy 50 + lease 150 = ~$2.1M capex + ~$450k over 3 months
Jordan: Can we reshape traffic across regions first? APAC has spare slots in partner region.
Liam: Networking: cross-region routing adds ~30ms RTT and egress cost +18%. Good for async workloads (embeddings, batch rerank) but not for chat with 50-100ms target.
Maya: Action items: 
- @Santiago update forecast with 95th percentile traffic and a burst-day scenario (due Tue 09:00).
- @ops-bot run a 20% batch-size canary across two zones and report error/latency deltas by EOD.
- @finproc gather lease quotes from 2 vendors + one reseller by Thu EOD.
- @Jordan evaluate regional routing fallback for non-interactive endpoints and surface routing policy.
Santiago: I'll add a cold-start and model-eviction simulation. Will present two plans: buy-heavy (lower unit cost, slower ramp) vs lease-heavy (fast ramp, higher TCO) with 12-month TCO.
finproc: Also checking tax/treatment differences for Q2 reporting; lease may be OPEX that helps near-term margins.
Maya: If we lease, we must request pinned capacity (no cross-tenant preemption) for hosted-api. Also need to update autoscaler quotas.
ops-bot: Note: current autoscaler max_nodes=1200. Adding >400 nodes requires raising quota. Opening cloud quota request now.
Liam: I'll file the quota ticket: INC-2026-3412 (cloud quota increase for hosted-api).
Jordan: Quick trade-off calc: paying 30% premium on 3-month lease gets us capacity in ~2 weeks vs 12 weeks for buys — aligns with May 10 partner date.
Maya: Team leaning mixed: lease immediate 150 cards, buy 80 across Q3. Anyone object?
Santiago: +1
Jordan: +1
Liam: +1
finproc: +1 pending final quotes
Maya: I'll draft a short exec memo with numbers, timelines, risk table, and preferred recommendation (mixed). Will share by EOD tomorrow.
ops-bot: Created ticket HOSTED-Q2-CAPACITY-2026 assigned to infra-proc.
Maya: Thanks all — moving follow-ups into the tickets. Closing thread here, ping me for urgent updates.
